national_baseline: National baseline for Vegetated Swale (practice synthesis — not adopted regulation). Where swale bottom width is specified (n=6), values cluster around 24 inches (range 24 inches–24 inches). Where swale longitudinal slope is specified (n=10), values cluster around 0.5 percent (range 0.5 percent–5 percent). Associated site water-quality depth (not practice-specific) in the same manuals (n=28) range 0.37 inches–1.61 inches (mode 1 inches) — site-wide sizing context, not a vegetated swale-only rule. Associated max drawdown / dewatering time in the same manuals (n=36) range 4 hours–120 hours (mode 72 hours) — site-wide sizing context, not a vegetated swale-only rule. Associated SHWT separation in the same manuals (n=31) range 12 inches–120 inches (mode 24 inches) — site-wide sizing context, not a vegetated swale-only rule. Use the controlling jurisdiction manual for project design. Prefer retention/runoff reduction where soils and groundwater allow.

regional_modifiers.title: Cold climate / freeze-thaw
regional_modifiers.text: Cold-climate manuals often adjust underdrain depth, planting, and winter maintenance for freeze-thaw. Verify frost-line and snowmelt criteria in the controlling manual.

regional_modifiers.title: Coastal / high water table
regional_modifiers.text: Coastal and high-water-table settings may reduce infiltration credit and require underdrains or impermeable liners. Use SHWT separation values from the matrix when present; otherwise defer to local criteria.

regional_modifiers.title: Karst / bedrock
regional_modifiers.text: Karst and shallow-bedrock settings often require lined facilities or prohibit untreated infiltration. Do not assume unlined infiltration from national defaults.

regional_modifiers.title: Arid / semi-arid
regional_modifiers.text: Arid-region manuals may use larger capture depths, different planting palettes, and tighter water budgets. Confirm media specs and irrigation constraints locally.

Statistics count only values whose supporting quote was found in the source manual and states the value (strict citation check).
